market.worldSizeUSD_B_range: India sheet metal fabrication market: $152.3M (2024) to $262.1M by 2033 (5.76%/yr, 2025-2033) per IMARC. Broader India metal fabrication market: $2.91B (2025) to $3.96B by 2031 (5.27%/yr) per one estimate, or 6.38%/yr by 2030 per another.
market.domesticSlice: Craftsman Automation Ltd (listed, much larger diversified player, est. 1986, Coimbatore) covers sheet-metal fabrication including railway bogey fabrication and AC coach panels across 8 satellite units — sheet-metal sub-segment revenue not separately disclosed.

structureFacts: Growth drivers: automotive, aerospace, and heavy-machinery demand; infrastructure/construction; 'Make in India' policy push for local manufacturing and export capability
AS9100 and NADCAP certification adoption is cited as a structural shift enabling higher-margin export business (aero-engine components) for Indian sheet-metal players
EV production and renewable energy expansion also cited as regional (Asia-Pacific) demand drivers

adoptionStructure.note: Precision/tolerance capability, certification (ISO 9001 baseline; AS9100/NADCAP for aerospace/defence customers), rapid prototyping/small-batch flexibility, multi-industry serviceability, and export compliance/quality systems for international customers drive vendor selection.
